description: This file defines the interface and classes for socket port management within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations for SocketPort, SocketStream, SocketDatagram, and SocketListner, along with their methods and internal state management, focusing on socket operations such as opening, closing, accepting connections, and data transmission.

classes.name: SocketPort
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic socket port with methods for managing socket state, data transmission, and connection handling.

classes.name: SocketStream
classes.description: Derived class representing a stream-oriented socket, such as TCP, with methods for sending and receiving data streams.

classes.name: SocketDatagram
classes.description: Derived class representing a datagram-oriented socket, such as UDP, with methods for sending and receiving discrete data packets.

classes.name: SocketListner
classes.description: Class managing listening sockets, accepting incoming connections, and handling socket events.

classes.name: SocketPort::EXTERNAL
classes.description: Macro or specifier indicating external linkage or visibility for the SocketPort class.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the socket port as a bitmask.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node identifier for the socket, with an assertion that the socket is not open unless it's a datagram.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the socket (DATAGRAM, STREAM, etc.).

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in listening state.

methods.name: IsConnecting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in connecting state.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: IsForcedClosing
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in a forced closing state.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has encountered an error.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Returns the local node identifier.

methods.name: LocalNode (setter)
methods.description: Sets the local node identifier.

methods.name: RemoteNode
methods.description: Returns the remote node identifier.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the host address of the remote node.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the host address of the local node.

methods.name: ReceivedNode
methods.description: Returns the node identifier of the last received message.

methods.name: ReceivedInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface index of the last received message.

methods.name: SendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured send buffer size.

methods.name: ReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured receive buffer size.

methods.name: SocketSendBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the socket's receive buffer size.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Resets internal counters for bytes sent and received.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live (TTL) value for the socket.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Enables or disables broadcast on the socket.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group, optionally with a source.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group, optionally with a source.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket with a specified wait time and optional interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers socket event handling.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send data through the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to receive data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify about state changes.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning the remote node ID.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Puts the socket into listening mode.

methods.name: Accept (overload)
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns the socket handle and remote node ID.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the socket port.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the socket's error state.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the internal critical section.

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle for the resource interface.

methods.name: SocketMode
methods.description: Determines the socket mode based on the socket type.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the socket events to monitor.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as opened.

methods.name: Accepted
methods.description: Marks the socket as accepted.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs a read operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns the buffer for socket operations.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Constructs a socket with specified local node and interface.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for the socket to open within a timeout.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the socket to close within a timeout.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for ongoing write operations to complete.
